Analyze alerts, events, alarms, and performance indicators and take appropriate action to prevent or minimize service disruptions. Identify abnormal network conditions and initiate troubleshooting and escalation procedures. Monitor network availability, connectivity, performance, and capacity. Maintain awareness of the operational status of mission-critical infrastructure and services. Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, hardware, configuration, and service-related issues. Assess incident severity and operational impact and escalate issues in accordance with established procedures. Ability to work independently and effectively in a mission-critical operational environment. Ability to support shift operations, including nights, weekends, holidays, or other non-standard hours as required. Active Secret security clearance required.
